# PR #2058: Patch: Stinkyscape S08, the trade cards

Closes #1864

I've built the three Stinkyscape trade cards, Siva 1 (S #87), The Syndicate (S #164) and The Trade Union (S #165). Each stub now has a real script with tests in the same file. The engine gains the small pieces they needed, five rulings are added, and the cards' own spec and BUILD rows are updated. Every gate I ran locally passed. The set stays behind R1420's gate: there is no pending fragment, no golden trace moved, the shipped totals are unchanged, and `catalog.json` differs only in the three cards' `loc`.

## Engine changes (with their own tests in `crates/engine/tests/rules/tradable.rs`)
- **Tradable is read through the layers** (`trade::is_tradable` now calls `layers::unit_has`, as `alt_play::is_cloaked` does). An aura can now lend it. For a card in hand the layered keywords include everything `card_keywords` returned, so nothing that was Tradable stops being Tradable.
- **New hand aura** `trade::tradable_hand_aura()`, which lends Tradable to every card in its controller's hand (R1864002).
- **New `Script.trades_per_turn` read** (`TradesPerTurnHook`). `trades_per_turn_of` returns the larger of the player's own figure and the most any card acting on their field gives; it never adds them. A fused card keeps the largest of its ingredients' figures (R1864004).
- **A trigger on `traded` is handed the traded card.** `triggers::queue_trigger` writes `tradedId` into the queue entry, and cards read it with `traded_card_of(ctx)`. The id lives only in `state.trigger_queue`, which no view shows (R1864003). The two reads are re-exported in the prelude.
- Three fixture Field Spells (indices 18383–18385) and three tests, `r1864002_…`, `r1864003_…` and `r1864004_…`.

## Cards
- **Siva 1:** the Cry picks one random enemy Unit that Allure can reach and whose tags (granted ones included) hold Acclaimed. The pick is drawn as the Cry resolves, then Allured through the engine's own delayed Allure (`DELAYED_ALLURE_HOOK`). With none, it does nothing and draws nothing. The Radiant face, with none, summons a random shipped Acclaimed Unit for the opponent, Freezes it and Allures it; a full enemy row summons nothing. 8 tests.
- **The Syndicate:** the aura, plus a trigger on its controller's own Trades that rolls once out of `PERCENT`. Below `exileChance` the card is exiled; below `exileChance + radiantChance` it is made Radiant; otherwise nothing. A card the Trade's draw took straight back rolls nothing. 9 tests.
- **The Trade Union:** the aura; the Radiant face gives `trades` Trades a turn through `param()`. 7 tests.

## Rulings and docs
- New notes: `R1864000` and `R1864001` (Siva's two faces), `R1864002` (the hand aura and layered Tradable), `R1864003` (The Syndicate's roll and the card hand-off), `R1864004` (Trades a turn).
- Edited:
  - `R1838000`: two cross-references to the new notes.
  - `spec/06-keywords.md`: the Tradable row.
  - `spec/08-catalog.md`: rows 87, 164 and 165.
  - `spec/10-engine-guide.md`: `tradesPerTurn` added to the Script list.
  - `spec/11-rulings.md`: a provenance paragraph.
  - `BUILD.md`: row S 164.
  - `crates/cards/README.md`: a read-table row for `traded_card_of`.
- `spec/INDEX.md` was regenerated by `cargo jackioh spec index`.

**Rows the build corrected:**
- **Spec row 87** said the pick is among the enemy's "acting Units". It now says "the enemy Units Allure reaches (never a carried, buried or Dormant one)", because Allure cannot steal a Unit a carrier holds.
- **Spec row 164** loses its "NEW (S08)" tag and now says a card the draw took straight back rolls nothing.
- **BUILD row S 164** says the same.
- `docs/radiant-audit.md` and `docs/stinkyscape-set.md` are unchanged.

## Testing
- `cargo fmt --check`: clean.
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean, after replacing one `iter().any(==)` with `contains` in a new test.
- `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`: exit 0; 36 suites, 14593 passed, 0 failed, 14 ignored (the existing daily tests). Nothing changed under `apps/web/src/wire/` or `crates/cards/luau/`.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test rules tradable`: 12 passed. `cargo test -p jackioh-cards stinkyscape`: all passed (24 card tests).
- `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check` and `spec check` (1267 rulings) all passed.
- `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200`: 200 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`, both without and with `--parent-bin` (the base commit built in a temporary worktree, since removed): kind internal, stage 2 ran, no cards, no problems. So no shipped card plays differently.
- **Not run locally:** the web vitest step. No file under `apps/` changed.

## Where I departed from the plan, or decided something the issue didn't settle
- **The card hand-off takes no player.** The plan's `traded_card_after(state, player)` looked for the first `shuffledIn` for that player. Mine returns the next event still waiting to be dispatched (skipping a held-back cast-on-draw `drawn`), and only when it is a `shuffledIn`. That is exactly the Trade's own shuffle-in. It also stays correct when a full deck turned the card away, and when the traded card is owned by the other player and goes into their deck. In that last case The Syndicate's library check means nothing rolls.
- **Luck doesn't apply to The Syndicate's roll** (R987: a roll with no better side). I chose this over rolling it again for each point of Luck, and a test proves Feng Shui adds no roll.
- **The two chances are one roll in back-to-back bands**, as spec row 164 has it: exile is 0–29, Radiant takes the next 30 (or 70 on the Radiant face). Past 100 combined, Radiant takes what is left. I rejected two independent rolls.
- **Hand views don't list a keyword lent by an aura**, as with Cloaked's aura (R243). The Trade control follows `legalActions`, `tradeReason` and `trades`, which all read the layered value.
- **Siva's Allure** reuses the engine's delayed Allure through the `delay` verb instead of adding a new verb, so the Luau API and `jackioh.luau` stay unchanged. Its list of candidates stays in the card file rather than a new engine helper.
- **Tests beyond the plan:**
  - The Syndicate: Luck adds no roll, and `exileChance` is read through `param`.
  - The Trade Union: when it leaves the field, the limit drops back at once and the Trade already made still counts. R1864004 states this.

## Worth a second look
- `is_tradable` now computes the layers for each hand card in `legal_actions` and `view_for`, as `is_cloaked` already does.
- `queue_trigger` writes `tradedId` only when a trigger answers `traded`. No shipped card does, which is why the golden traces and the classify games don't move.
